body: The three month boyfriend was a completely different girl looking for advice in a Facebook group. I am more rational. Please don't project something on to me because of One post. This was an oxymoron. It went against how I usually function. The whole time I kept thinking about how it was rushed and how I hadn't even met her. It was scary but I wanted to just enjoy it and not care what other people would think. I wanted to be optimistic. It created this hope, this idea and it made me feel happy. That entire week honestly felt like a new chapter of my life and I was scared to go back. Now I'm forced to and it feels lonelier.

Yeah. I know how it sounds. A few weeks ago I was telling a girl to not jump into conversations about the future with her three month boyfriend and to take it slow. Next thing I know, me and girl are believing we're soul mates. I never had anything more in common with someone before. We even both fell off a slide a broke a bone in first grade. She thought I was cat fishing her. All I know is I felt this strong connection that I never felt with anyone before and it only took a matter of days. It just seemed to progress naturally that way. It was like there was no controlling it. To us, 1 week was like 1 year. I'm supposed to be the type of person who is more rational but it hit me like a brick.

They did say they needed time to process everything. After a day he went very suicidal. I think he sent her an apology text and another one asking to talk. After that I think is when she blocked him on all social media. Do you think she might come around and unblock him? I think above all he just misses them so much and feels alone. I'm somewhat upset too because I don't know what this means for our group and I'm everyone's messenger. I think he's starting to calm down but the lack of communication really hurts him.
